title: EmailComposerAutopopulationResponse
description: Response containing all data needed to autopopulate the email composer for Practitioner Initial workflow

subject.description: Email subject line from template (may be empty if not configured)

body.description: Email body/template from settings (may be empty if not configured)

reasons.description: Array of selected outreach reasons with title and instruction, sorted by selection order

emailConfiguration.description: Email recipient preferences configuration. Null when no outreach settings are saved for this type/cycle (see the operation description).

dynamicFields.description: Map of dynamic field keys to their resolved values (can include strings, arrays, or objects)

toEmails.description: Recipient email addresses to prefill on the composer's To field (CP-37576). Empty unless the org has enabled CAQH-extraction autopopulation for a single, eligible practitioner-credentialing workflow.

OutreachReasonValueDto.description: Outreach reason value with title and instruction
